newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips ease, SAX closes 0.66 pts down.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips ease, SAX closes 0.66 pts down.

text.p: Slovak blue chips eased in quiet trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, as the SAX index dipped 0.66 points to 181.11 mainly on losses to steel maker VSZ.
VSZ closed down 10 crowns at 610 and brokers said it might fall below 600 crowns soon, if the trend continues.
The largest issue on the BSE, oil refiner Slovnaft, eased one crown to 900, but traded only 94 shares on the BSE floor.
Brokers said they the current decline of the bourse was a reflection of the turbulent developments on the country's crown market over the last month.
Overall, volume decreased to 290,746 shares, from 356,518 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover rose to 202.75 million crowns, from 144.72 million.
